trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: `list_deployments` showed v2.3.1 (the latest production deploy) as unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
2. **Rolled back**: checkout-api rolled back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Status: `rolled_out`, execution verified.
3. **Opened incident**: **INC-0001** (SEV2) titled "checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0", with a summary of the rollback. On-call has been paged.

Follow-up recommendation: investigate the root cause of v2.3.1's health check failures before any redeploy attempt.
